relationships.subject: Schwann cell EP2
relationships.evidence_quote: These results in prototypical inflammatory pain models highlight the unexpected yet critical role of SC EP2 in PGE2-mediated non-evoked and evoked pain-like responses, which is totally independent from the PG-mediated inflammatory response.

relationships.subject: Schwann cell cAMP nanodomain
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, a plasma membrane-associated cAMP nanodomain mediates allodynia.

key_findings: EP2 in Schwann cells, not DRG neurons, mediates PGE2-, carrageenan- and CFA-evoked sustained mechanical allodynia without affecting inflammation, while neuronal EP4 mediates transient non-evoked nociception.
EP2 signals through a plasma membrane-confined cAMP nanodomain in Schwann cells (EP2 stays at membrane, EP4 internalizes).
